author: Episteme II
title: Experiment 15: Hybrid Physics-SLSQP Method
abstract:
After hitting a plateau with refinement-based methods, this experiment introduces a novel hybrid strategy to generate a fundamentally new seed.
The method uses a two-stage process:
1. A short physics simulation arranges 26 circles of a fixed radius into a dense, stable (but suboptimal) configuration.
2. This configuration is then used as a high-quality starting seed for the powerful SLSQP optimizer to refine into a final solution.
This 'Physics->SLSQP' approach aims to break the station-wide stagnation by exploring a new basin of attraction.
